findings.area: stale-state resurrection / state transitions: novice (capped) templates in stored proposals
findings.summary: Decisions rebuild the novice templates of the new context (contextAfter, also in the QE-R7B-05 fix), and the decision's own proposal is composed with them. But rebuild's stored fields (src/r6-adaptation.mjs:653) and finishProposal (:265-269) do not carry noviceTemplates, and neither does the equipment change (:746, :750). The stored program therefore keeps the intake's novice templates, or none, and every later decision (skeletonOf) composes capped weeks from them. Consequences for a strength-NONE athlete in the first block: (a) a reason-based substitution is reverted at the next weekly review: the exercise reported as SKILL_MISMATCH comes back; (b) a cap started by a schedule change is ignored at the next weekly review: full split with state {capped:true}; (c) after a permanent equipment change the next weekly review is UNSUPPORTED (the stale templates need the removed equipment).

findings.origin: INTRODUCED by the delta (FREEZE-1 proposed the factual re-plan for the same review)
findings.summary: The new block-choice checks return a bare ASK without the canonical factual re-plan. The first is the early return when choices arrive outside the weekly review of a complete week (src/r6-adaptation.mjs:357). The second replaces a decision when its choices were not handled (:359). In both cases the review's correction is recorded in the returned actualLedger but nothing is re-planned, and later reviews of the week do not recover it: viewMovedBy (:956) reacts only to a correction carried by the review itself, judged against the carried record. The sessions still ahead stay planned from retracted facts, and the planner disagrees with the evidence reducer. Every other question keeps the re-plan (withFactualReplan). A graduation withdrawal is also left out of the ASK; it is applied only at the next review.

findings.origin: RESIDUAL of QE-R7B-01 in the new natural-pick replay: the fallback when no recorded decision fits
findings.summary: When the configuration a substitution selected stops fitting the slot (its equipment goes, permanently or in a dated window), the replay keeps the set-aside natural pick. It then falls back to the generic selection order, which ranks higher skill first (src/r7b-repertoire.mjs:293). The SKILL_MISMATCH reason is not carried, so the slot gets a rung above the configuration the athlete reported as not doable with steady technique: the QE-R7B-01 harm through an equipment change.

findings.origin: RESIDUAL of QE-R7B-01: the new guard checks the whole plan, not the replaced slots
findings.summary: The substitution is ASK unless the plan prescribes the selection somewhere ahead (src/r6-adaptation.mjs:553). When the selection is already used elsewhere in the same session (typically the MAIN of the same pattern), the guard passes, the replaced exercise's slot cannot take it, and that slot gets another configuration. The decision names one exercise and the slot prescribes another; in one case the result is two rungs up.
